flows.title: Dashboard login journey (React)
flows.summary: A visitor hitting a protected page waits for a silent token refresh, is redirected to /login if there is no session, signs in (with an optional 2FA code step) and is sent back to the page they came from.

nodes.label: Open protected page
nodes.description: All app pages sit under a route whose element is ProtectedRoute, so every visit passes through it first.

nodes.label: Restoring session?
nodes.description: While isInitializing is true (silent refresh with a stored refresh token), a spinner shows. It neither flashes the dashboard nor bounces to /login yet.

nodes.label: Authenticated?
nodes.description: Unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login, remembering the original location in router state.
nodes.snippet: return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} />;

nodes.label: Requested page
nodes.description: Outlet renders the requested child route.

nodes.label: Login page
nodes.description: Email, password and tenant form. Submitting calls performLogin. A visitor who is already authenticated is sent straight on.

nodes.label: login() API call
nodes.description: AuthContext.login calls the identity API, stores the tokens and clears cached query state.

nodes.label: 2FA required?
nodes.description: If the server says the password was right but 2FA is on, the credentials are held in component state and the code step is shown.

nodes.label: Enter 2FA code
nodes.description: verifyCode repeats login with the code. A wrong code clears the field and shows an error without leaving the step.

nodes.label: Show login error
nodes.description: Any other failure shows the server's problem detail, or a generic message.

nodes.label: Back to origin page
nodes.description: On success the user is navigated to the page they came from (or /), replacing the login entry in history.

notes: Silent refresh happens in AuthContext at boot (auth-context.tsx, isInitializing); its failure path was only skimmed.
Demo-account sign-in (onPickDemo) goes through the same performLogin and is not drawn separately.
